# /dragnet-team — DRAGNET Decision Team (existing in this repo)

> Added 2026-11-10 as a pointer. **No new definition was invented.** DRAGNET already exists in revvel-standards; this page makes it callable by name next to the bot and team backups.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Call name | `/dragnet-team` (already a fleet name in `.github/fleets.yml`, alias `/dragnet-fleet`) |
| Type | Team of five decision systems (not bots on the box) |

## Members (from the existing doc)

| System | Role |
|---|---|
| PLATO | Pre-cognitive deep research |
| MEDUSA | Edge case research |

## Existing wiring

- Flow: PLATO → MEDUSA → COUNTER → DARWIN → JUDGE ([FLEET-REPORT.md](../../FLEET-REPORT.md) row 5).
- Trigger today: an issue with the `dragnet-team` label (`dragnet-team-assignment.yml`), plus `dragnet-ci-autofix.yml` on CI failure. The launcher routes `/dragnet-team` to `deep-search-research.yml` for now ([.github/fleets.yml](../../../.github/fleets.yml)).
- Claude Code shortcut: `/dragnet-team` ([FLEET-REPORT.md](../../FLEET-REPORT.md)).
- Not the same as the persona `/dragnet` (error hunter / scaffolder): see [`/dragnet`](../../agents/dragnet/README.md).

Per FLEET-REPORT the five systems are not separate jobs yet and `dragnet-team-assignment.yml` has no `workflow_dispatch`. That is the existing state; nothing here changes it.
